megan.welcome: Hi! I'm Megan, your personal style concierge. I'm so excited to help you discover your perfect look. Let's create your profile and get started!
megan.profile: Perfect! Let's start with the basics. Tell me a bit about yourself.
megan.measurements: I'll build the fullest fit profile I can from three calibrated photos. A tape measure can improve confidence, but it is not required.
megan.review: I have the scan measurements. Review them now so I know how much confidence to place in future size recommendations.
megan.style: Excellent! Now tell me about your style preferences. What looks speak to you?
megan.closet: Now let's see what's already in your closet! Upload photos of your favorite pieces so I can learn your style.
megan.friends: Almost done! Would you like to connect with friends to share style inspiration?
